verdict.rationale:
AWS docs explicitly describe OIDC federation for external CI systems like GitHub Actions connecting to AWS without long-lived keys (aws-docs-13), IAM roles providing only temporary security credentials with no password/access keys (aws-docs-12, aws-docs-46), and AWS's own recommendation to use identity federation over long-term IAM users (aws-docs-47, aws-docs-29). This covers the core CI/workload identity federation → short-lived credential story end to end via IAM identity providers and role assumption.

missing for 10: a concrete step-by-step end-to-end tutorial/example (e.g., a GitHub Actions OIDC setup walkthrough) and independent/hands-on corroboration that the flow works as documented.
